title: Card network authorization return sent
description: This event represents the response the Pismo platform sends to the card network in the online workflow for one operation. The platform issues it immediately before it sends the same response to the network. You can use it to verify that the authorization event emitted for this operation has the same result as the one sent to the network. For more information, see the Authorization events guide.

mti.title: Message type ID
mti.description: Card network request type. Can be used to identify whether the request is an Advice (Standin flow) or not. For more information, see MTI

advice_detail_code.title: Advice detail code
advice_detail_code.description: Details why the card network issued this advice. This field is only used for Mastercard requests and it represents the value received in DE60 subfield 2 of the specification, if it is present in the card network message.

advice_reason_code.title: Advice reason code
advice_reason_code.description: Why the card network issued this advice. For messages other than advices, this field is null. In Mastercard requests this field represents the value received in the DE60 subfield 1 of the specification. For Visa requests, this field represents the value received in the F63.4 of the specification.

anti_fraud_http_status_code.title: Anti-fraud HTTP status code
anti_fraud_http_status_code.description: Status code returned from anti-fraud API endpoint

arqc_presence.title: ARQC (Authorization Request Cryptogram) present flag
arqc_presence.description: Authorization Request Cryptogram. Indicates whether the authorization request was performed and the cryptogram information (field 55 of the Card Network specification) was present in the message.

authorization_code.title: Authorization request authorization code
authorization_code.description: An alphanumeric 6-digit code generated for an authorization request that can be used to relate this event to other events associated with the same authorization. For more information, see the Linking authorization events guide.

authorization_region.title: Authorization region
authorization_region.description: AWS region of the connector that processed the authorization event.

bin.title: Bank identification number (BIN)
bin.description: The first 6 or 8  digits of the PAN for the card used in the purchase

card_hash.title: Card PAN hash
card_hash.description: Hash of card used in the authorization

cvv2_presence.title: CVV2 present flag
cvv2_presence.description: CVV2 present in the purchase flag

denial_code.title: Denial code
denial_code.description: Pismo custom error code, this code identifies which stateless or stateful rule denied the authorization. See Validation codes for authorization events for more information

duration_ms.title: Process duration
duration_ms.description: Time, in miliseconds, spent to finish the authorization process

error.title: Error
error.description: Error that happened when trying to call our distributor API.

host_connected.title: Connected host IP
host_connected.description: Source IP address for network authorization

ica.title: Interbank Card Association (ICA) number
ica.description: Interbank Card Association (ICA) number. The issuer's sign-on ID. An Interbank Card Association Number (ICA) is a four-digit number MasterCard assigns to a financial institution, third party processor, or other member to identify the member in transactions.

incoming_response_code.title: Incoming response code
incoming_response_code.description: Incoming response code from the acquirer

installment_data.title: Installment data
installment_data.description: Number of installments of the purchase - Mastercard only

mdes_message_type.title: MDES message type
mdes_message_type.description: MDES (Mastercard Digital Enablement Service) message type - Mastercard only.

network_code.title: Network code
network_code.description: Type of card used in purchase - Mastercard only

origin.title: Transaction origin
origin.description: Identify from where one transaction was issued, if it is from STRIKER('Rebatedor') or migrated from historical data

pin_terminal_capability.title: PIN terminal capability
pin_terminal_capability.description: Terminal PIN presence capability - Mastercard only

pos_cardholder_presence.title: POS cardholder presence
pos_cardholder_presence.description: Cardholder presence at POS - Mastercard only

pos_transaction_status.title: POS transaction status
pos_transaction_status.description: POS transaction status type - Mastercard only

processing_code.title: Processing code
processing_code.description: Transaction procssing code. See Processing codes and transaction types for more information

replacement_amount.title: Replacement amount
replacement_amount.description: Original purchase value. This field is used for partial cancellations - VISA only.

response_code.title: Response code
response_code.description: Response code returned to the network

server_id.title: Server ID
server_id.description: Customer unique ID for network authorizations sign-on

tcp_bytes_written.title: TCP bytes written
tcp_bytes_written.description: Number of bytes written back to the network.

tcp_error.title: TCP error
tcp_error.description: Error that happened when trying to respond to the network.

token_requestor_id.title: Token requestor ID
token_requestor_id.description: ID assigned by the token service provider to the token requestor. The token requestor ID is required for Card-on-File token request messages - Mastercard only

track1_presence.title: Track1 present flag
track1_presence.description: Track1 data presence in the purchase flag

track2_presence.title: Track2 present flag
track2_presence.description: Track2 data presence in the purchase flag

wallet.title: Wallet ID
wallet.description: Wallet (Apple pay, Google Pay ...) used in purchase - Mastercard only
